204.description: The result was applied to the onboarding, had already been applied by an earlier delivery of the same callback, or named a park the onboarding has since left and was dropped.

400.description:
`ASYNC_CALLBACK_RAW_BODY_REQUIRED`: The callback arrived without a body the signature could be verified over.

`ASYNC_CALLBACK_PROVIDER_KEY_INVALID`: The provider key is not made of lower-case letters, digits and underscores.

`ASYNC_CALLBACK_AUTHENTICATION_FAILED`: No connector adapter that accepts callbacks is registered under this provider key.

`INVALID_STEP_DATA`: The submitted data violates the current step; `errors` maps each refused field to its reasons (`UNKNOWN`, `REQUIRED`, `INVALID`, `CALLBACK_ONLY`, or a connector's own), and the onboarding stays where it was.

allOf.description: The engine's own error envelope. `code` is the stable identifier a client branches on; `message` repeats it. A code that adds detail properties is described on the operation that returns it.
allOf.title: ApiError

500.description:
A connector failed in a way its adapter raises as a plain error rather than one of the codes below: an `http_request` call that could not be sent or answered with an unexpected status, a Sumsub level or credential that does not resolve, or a Veriff credential or payload that does not resolve. The framework answers with its own envelope, so there is no `code` to branch on; the connector, the step and the reason are in the audit trail.

`TWILIO_VERIFY_UNAVAILABLE`: Twilio Verify could not be reached, or answered with an error the adapter does not map to an outcome.

`SENDGRID_EMAIL_UNAVAILABLE`: SendGrid could not be reached, or answered with an error the adapter does not map to an outcome.

`SUMSUB_UNAVAILABLE`: Sumsub could not be reached, or answered with an error the adapter does not map to an outcome.

`VERIFF_UNAVAILABLE`: Veriff could not be reached, or answered with an error the adapter does not map to an outcome.

`CLIENT_WEBHOOK_DELIVERY_FAILED`: The client webhook for this move could not be delivered; the outbox entry was returned to pending for the worker to retry.

oneOf.description: NestJS's default error envelope, returned where the framework answers instead of the engine: request validation (`400`, `message` lists each violated rule), the admin bearer guard (`401`, `403`, `503`), and a `500` on the submit and provider-callback routes where a connector adapter fails with a plain error rather than a coded refusal.

503.description:
`ASYNC_CALLBACK_SIGNATURE_INVALID`: A configuration gap on the engine side: the adapter declares no `callbackAuth`, or its signing secret is not configured. Retry once the connector settings are fixed.

`CONNECTOR_NOT_CONFIGURED`: A connector the step calls has a required setting with no value; carries `connectorId` and `key`.
